captions.text: Sol 1: just the two landing pods
Month 1: the pressurised rover rolls off the cargo pod
Month 3: small fission reactors give power day and night,
Month 7: the plant starts making oxygen and
methane from CO2 air and ice
and in month 9 a sealed walkway to it
Month 12: a second habitat, linked in month 13
Month 14: walls of bagged soil block some of the radiation
Month 16: a big dish to talk to Earth
Month 21: the ascent vehicle's tanks keep filling
Month 26: Earth and Mars line up again
